sections.h2: Parliament passed the Act in four days, and it took effect on 22 August 2026

chart.title: Both Houses passed the Act in four days; it took effect on 22 August 2026
events: Nine-judge bench: royalty is not a tax; states may tax mineral rights and land
Follow-up order: states may recover dues back to 1 April 2005, in instalments
MMDR Amendment Bill passed by both Houses, about 45 minutes of debate
Presidential assent: the Act is No. 20 of 2026
Act comes into force on publication of S.O. 4642(E)

sections.means: The Act reverses the 2024 ruling by ordinary law, not constitutional amendment, and took effect within days of assent.
sections.todo: Watch the Centre's curative petition, pending since September 2025, which could still change the 2024 ruling.
